name: scan-consent-via-permission
body: The distributed `codebase-navigator` prompt must not carry a bespoke scan-consent ritual. Scan authorization is delegated to opencode's per-call tool permission: the navigator's frontmatter grants `apg_scan: ask`, so opencode prompts the user on each call and the user may choose "always allow" to suppress future prompts. No "ask the user first" / "get explicit approval before starting one" / "ask the user before running a scan" / "(after user approval)" scan wording and no `question`-tool scan-consent step may remain. The stale-graph intent is retained: when the graph is missing or stale the agent runs `apg_scan` rather than guessing, and never re-runs a scan silently. Prose; assessed by review.
